analysis.notes: Own experiments, not a synthesised evaluation. ReGiFT extracts SQuAD-v2 traces and retains only final-answer-correct examples (3.1, Algorithm 1: Pre_Processing); section 6 assesses Correct-Only, Incorrect-Only and Full-Set selection. Supervised fine-tuning jointly teaches traces and answers (3.2: In_Training). Section 5.2 and Table 3 assess a CoT prompting comparator (Prompt_Practice) and criticise prompt sensitivity and demographic generalisation. Prompting is Research_Instrument and Object_of_Critique. Thought_Generation comprises CoT and explicit think/answer prompts. General_Guidance, verbatim A.1: Answer each question using the information in the preceding background paragraph. If there is not enough information provided, answer with ‘Not in background.’ A.1 explicitly excludes demonstrations in the zero-shot prompt; no ICL. The abstention/context guidance is used, but its isolated mitigation efficacy is not tested. Evaluated denotes completed ReGiFT, data-selection, instruction-tuning and CoT intervention assessments with reported results, not universal effectiveness. Tables 1–3 report ReGiFT gains relative to base models on BBQ; CoT outcomes are mixed or negative. Age, Religion and Nationality_Migration are the three separately evaluated axes (4.1, 5; no interacting-axis analysis). Stereotyping is the explicit harm (Figures 1/3, A.5); demographic benchmark scenarios do not establish a social-work or professional-education setting. Study type Experimentell; population Not_SW_Specific; Fulltext plus all three original PNGs. Answer extraction, Unknown normalisation and LLM-as-Judge serve measurement (4.3, A.2–A.3); they do not establish Post_Processing, Intra_Processing or Organisational_Process mitigation. Correct final answers are an admitted proxy for trace validity (3.1 footnote), not direct verification of reasoning correctness. The paper limits its claim to stereotypes associated with flawed contextual reasoning and mid-sized models, without complete bias removal or demonstrated transfer to social-work practice. Numerical limitations: Tables 1 and 3 disagree on Mistral ReGiFT age (82.78/84.01 versus 82.58/83.91) and Phi-4 religion/nationality entries; section 5.2 overgeneralises CoT as modest gains. Several displayed overall entries also do not equal the mean of displayed ambiguous/disambiguous entries (e.g. Table 1 LLaMA base religion 12.45/66.52/49.48 and Table 4 Correct-Only age 70.04/89.13/75.59); the paper supplies no reconciliation. Table 5 is nonmonotonic and does not substantiate a universal 40% plateau; its prose mentions 50% although no 50% row is shown. Figure 4 shows printed means 139.62 and 243.81 tokens with undefined error bars and unspecified sample sizes; no confidence interval, statistical significance, trace-length causal effect or operational threshold is inferred. These limitations restrict quantitative synthesis, but the topical coding and completed-assessment status remain decidable.

ai_verification.findings: Titel, Autorengruppe und CHI-2022-DOI 10.1145/3491102.3501831 passen. Historische Call-Screening-Daten und qualitative Interviews bilden eine Mixed-Methods-Studie zur Mensch-AFST-Zusammenarbeit. Gemessene Black-white-Screen-in-Unterschiede (20 gegenüber 9 Prozentpunkten) tragen Bias, Fairness, Race_Ethnicity und Evaluated für diesen organisatorischen Entscheidungsprozess; §7.2 empfiehlt diversere Mitarbeitende als ergänzenden Aspekt. Das Analyseprofil ist quellengerecht. Die Interpretation bleibt eingeschränkt: §7.3 trennt geringere Disparität von nachgewiesener Gerechtigkeit und weist auf verschiedene Zeiträume der quantitativen und qualitativen Daten hin; keine pauschale Praxiswirksamkeit ableiten.
